summary: fractal-test: a ci-local check's note always records how long it waited before ci-local started (pre_start_s). The value now goes to evidence-wrap through a FIFO the wrapper reads after the check ended, and fractal-test writes it only once it has drained all of the check's output; a plain file written when fractal-test happened to read the start line raced the wrapper's read, so on a loaded host the note said 'none' for a check that had started, and the time-limit test ejected merge groups

replay.detail: No record, signature or storage format changes: pre_start_s is the same input, now present whenever ci-local started.

rules.detail: The --time-limit rule is unchanged; only how its pre-start wait reaches the note.

compatibility.detail: Any evidence-wrap that takes --input-file reads the FIFO as it read the file; one that does not gets no pre_start_s, as before.

recovery.detail: Revert the change: pre_start_s is then sometimes 'none' again under load.
